welcome.title: A tour of the analysis page
welcome.text: This page sums up one reading of a gel: its lanes, its bands and what the densitometry measured. A one-minute tour; Esc leaves it, the Tour compass at the top brings it back.

steps.title: Where this analysis stands
steps.text: The gel image it reads, its status, when it was created and by whom.

steps.title: Annotate, then measure
steps.text: Annotate opens the editor to draw or detect lanes and bands, while the analysis can still be edited. Densitometry measures them: it appears once the gel has a band.

steps.title: The gel in numbers
steps.text: Lanes, bands, how many ladder lanes are calibrated in molecular weight, and the mean POI purity of the sample lanes once the densitometry has run.

steps.title: What still needs a look
steps.text: Data-quality remarks about this gel, a lane without a band or a missing calibration for instance. They never block the work.

steps.title: The gel and what was drawn on it
steps.text: Lanes outlined by type (sample, ladder, control), bands by type (POI in purple). Click the gel to see it large; in the large view, click a lane to find its row in the table below.

steps.title: The lanes and their samples
steps.text: One row per lane: its type, sample name, load and results. While the analysis is editable, click a cell to edit it; <kbd>Tab</kbd> and the arrows move between cells.
